The '''Blaster Target Board''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] training system manufactured by [[Capris Technologies]]. The board was a thin flexible sheet measuring two and a half [[Meter/Legends|meters]] by two and a half meters linked to a [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]] by a [[Scomp link/Legends|scomp link]]. A series of targets were projected on the screen which would be shot by the owner using their own blaster set for stun.
